KaTeX Runtime Assets
====================

This directory holds the KaTeX runtime used by the zoRecto pane.

Contents (populated during build):
- `katex.min.js`
- `katex.min.css`
- `fonts/` (all KaTeX font files)

How assets are provisioned:
- `npm run build` triggers `prebuild` which runs `scripts/copy-katex-assets.mjs`.
- The script copies files from `node_modules/katex/dist` into this folder.

Offline-first behavior:
- The reader pane loads local assets from this directory.
- If a local asset fails to load, it falls back to the KaTeX CDN.

Do not edit files here manually; they are generated by the build.
